title: Borlotti Bean Kheer
description: A hearty, comforting Indian-inspired dessert featuring borlotti beans and sweet spices.
instructions: Combine the borlotti beans, kheer, milk, sugar, cardamom, and cinnamon in a saucepan.
Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until the mixture thickens and the sugar dissolves.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until heated through.
Remove from heat and let cool slightly.
Serve warm or chilled, garnished with chopped nuts or cardamom pods if desired.
